trails.description_en: Iconic hike to the 14th-century Gergeti Trinity Church perched at 2,170m with stunning views of Mount Kazbek.
Multi-day trek through Upper Svaneti, passing medieval Svan towers and glacier-fed rivers.
High-alpine crossing via colorful Abudelauri Lakes at 3,000m. Crosses Chaukhi Pass at 3,338m.
Beautiful day hike through remote Tusheti connecting two medieval fortress villages.
Scenic valley walk along the Terek River past travertine pools and abandoned villages.
Easy nature walk through old-growth forest to a beautiful waterfall in Lagodekhi Protected Areas.
Day hike in one of Europe's largest national parks through mixed forests to alpine meadows.
Challenging high-altitude pass crossing at 3,338m with dramatic rock spires.
Short but stunning walk along the turquoise Abasha River canyon with cliff walkways.
Thrilling walk on a metal walkway suspended over the 100m deep Okatse Canyon.
Remote trek in Khevsureti connecting two medieval fortress villages through the Argun Gorge.

Short walk from the UNESCO-listed Ushguli village to the remote hamlet of Chvelpi.
Hike from Europe's highest continuously inhabited village to the base of Georgia's tallest mountain.
Remote glacier approach in the Svaneti highlands to Mount Laila.

Traverse from Mazeri to Etseri via the scenic Meziri Lake at high altitude.
Scenic ridge walk from Mestia via Hatsvali ski area to the Zuruldi viewpoint.
Epic multi-day traverse around Mount Laila connecting Tviberi and Mananauri villages.
Remote lake hike from Khaishi to the hidden Lakumura Lake in Lower Svaneti.
Hike to the Big and Small Okrostskali Lakes in the Svaneti highlands.
Alpine lake hike in Upper Svaneti to the beautiful Lake Memuli.
Cultural hike from Latali to the medieval Church of the Archangel Gabriel in Mheer.
Scenic village-to-village hike through classic Svaneti landscapes to remote Adishi.
High pass crossing from Kala to the Latpari Pass with sweeping mountain views.
Short loop hike above Mestia to the Cross viewpoint with panoramic mountain views.
Mountain pass hike from Etseri village to the scenic Bak Pass.
Valley hike to the beautiful Leiraki Waterfall and Tavrani valley.
Summit hike to Shuano Mountain in the Svaneti highlands.
Remote summit hike to Gvirgvina Mountain in Svaneti.

Red-marked trail from Diklo through Chigho to Dartlo via the scenic Tusheti ridges.
